git.note: Windows: PortableGit, because pi needs its bash.exe. macOS: dugite-native, the relocatable Git GitHub Desktop ships, because /usr/bin/git on a bare Mac is a stub that asks to install the Xcode tools. The version strings differ by platform; both carry Git 2.56.0.

herdr.note: Only an x86_64 Windows build exists; it runs under x64 emulation on Windows ARM64. SHA256 values match herdr.dev/latest.json and the GitHub release asset digests.

gh.note: SHA256 from gh_2.103.3_checksums.txt of the release. The Windows and macOS zips hold bin/gh(.exe) or gh_2.103.3_macOS_<arch>/bin/gh.

glab.note: SHA256 from the release's checksums.txt (gitlab-org/cli). The Windows zip holds bin/glab.exe; the macOS tarball holds bin/glab.

fd.note: pi downloads the latest fd on first start without a pin; this entry is provisioned into pi's bin folder first. The release ships no checksum file; SHA256 is the GitHub release asset digest, which scripts/check-stack.mjs compares against the downloaded bytes.

rg.note: ripgrep, provisioned like fd. SHA256 from the release's per-asset .sha256 files.

bun.note: Turned on by a recipe's tools list, not in the first install. The zips hold bun-<platform>/bun(.exe). x64 uses the -baseline builds, which need no AVX2, so a CPU or an emulator without AVX2 works (a VM, or x64 emulation on Windows ARM). Apple Silicon uses the regular aarch64 build. SHA256 from the release's SHASUMS256.txt (tag bun-v1.2.23).

npmGlobal.name: team-toon-tack
npmGlobal.note: Installed when the PM saves a Linear key, not in the first install.

piPackages.name: pi-herdr-agents
piPackages.note: PMs run the newest npm release by the PM's decision (the author runs a git fork: upstream 3.3.1 + PRs #84, #95, #99, the solutionSpace change of closed PR #87, and the fork-only exit hold). Checked against 3.8.0 on 2026-11-08. Still missing: the exit-hold event channel (pi-herdr-agents:exit-hold, closed PR #89) does not exist, which matters only to an extension that waits out a quota reset (the author's quota-resume), not to a PM; there is no solutionSpace parameter on subagent (closed PR #87). Now carried upstream: #99 (a child without auto-exit is asked once whether it is done), #94 (an auto-exit child waits for the children it launched), the /reload stale-context fix of #95, #84 (3.7.2: an auto-exit child stays open when pi reports an aborted run), and #112 (3.8.0: on Windows a launch script runs through an absolute bash from pi's shellPath, seam U10). 3.8.0 registers its nine routine tools (subagent and the rest) with pi's deferred exposure, so a model loads them through pi's tool_search first.

piPackages.name: pi-lens
piPackages.note: The author pins a git fork (wayne930242/pi-lens@1cdd03e: upstream master plus dispatch.disabledRunners, apmantza/pi-lens PR #5011, still open) to keep the dotnet-build runner off. npm 4.4.7 has no dispatch.disabledRunners key, so dotnet-build cannot be switched off. The profile ships no pi-lens config that uses it and PM repositories are not expected to hold .NET projects.

piPackages.name: @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk
piPackages.note: Pinned for the Claude Agent SDK's bundled claude 2.1.309, whose Keychain naming and device-key handling were read (design record, Keychain finding). pi-claude-bridge 0.9.3 asks for ^0.3.293 and ships no shrinkwrap, so without this entry a fresh install takes the newest 0.3.x. Installed before the bridge, it satisfies the bridge's range and npm does not nest a second copy. The SDK's platform packages are optional dependencies at the exact same version. pi lists it in settings.json like any package; it has no pi resources, so pi loads nothing from it.

piPackages.name: pi-claude-bridge
piPackages.note: PMs run the newest npm release by the PM's decision. Checked 2026-10-30: npm latest is still 0.9.3. The author's git fork (wayne930242/pi-claude-bridge@9822631) is that plus 33 unreleased upstream main commits and its own fixes, so what the fork has and 0.9.3 lacks includes: no Claude Code setting sources on the provider path (0.9.3 loads every source there), a pi 1.2.0+ requirement (0.9.3 accepts pi 0.86.1+), parallel tool calls lost after a non-streaming fallback (PR 225, open upstream), and a tool call pi never received keeping an MCP handler waiting (PR 226, open upstream).
